description: This file defines the TabHelperEclair class, which provides compatibility support for managing tabs with fragments in pre-Honeycomb Android versions. It extends the TabHelper base class and implements tab change handling, fragment attachment/detachment, and saving/restoring tab state.

classes.name: TabHelperEclair
classes.description: A helper class for managing tabs with fragments on Android versions earlier than Honeycomb, providing compatibility and fragment management via TabHost.

classes.name: DummyTabFactory
classes.description: A simple factory for creating dummy tab content views to satisfy TabHost requirements.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the TabHost, sets up the tab change listener.

methods.name: addTab
methods.description: Adds a new tab, manages associated fragment lifecycle.

methods.name: onTabChanged
methods.description: Handles tab switch events, manages fragment attachment/detachment and invokes callback methods.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves current tab state for restoration during configuration changes.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the previously saved tab state.
